title: [Main] Expense Management: make Expense Management Setup public; keep agent and corporate card surface internal
summary: Expense Management Setup table is now public for extensions to read and modify expense management settings, while agent-specific and corporate card fields remain internal.
key_points: Expense Management Setup table made public for accessing and maintaining company-wide expense settings
Agent-specific fields (Enable Agent, User Security ID, communication, notifications) marked as internal
Corporate card surface made internal as the feed is not yet mature for partner contracts
Three public enums (Expense Exchange Rate, Full Per Diem Calculation, Partial Day Rules) marked non-extensible
Extensions can read default-setup flags to avoid overwriting their own setup data
